changes.text: 拒绝病号上船那一条，读起来最不舒服，但记录里给的是存活推断，不是道德立场：健康的人在船上都难活，在他看来，躺在舱底、动弹不得的病人熬不过坏天气。本文推断，这种取舍的难处不在决定本身，而在它必须给出理由——两位医生提了建议，被否掉了，记述里写明了否决的理由。

The refusal of the sick man is the least comfortable paragraph to read, yet the record offers survival reasoning rather than a moral stance: fit men would find it hard enough to live in the boat, and in his view a sick man lying helpless in the bottom could not survive the heavy weather. This piece infers that the difficulty of such a trade-off lies less in the decision itself than in having to give reasons for it: the two doctors made a proposal, it was vetoed, and the account sets down why.
出海的风险明摆着。队长算过最坏情形：这趟冒险不会给留在岛上的人增加任何风险，冬天要吃饭的嘴也少了；船上只带六人一个月的口粮——「for if we did not make South Georgia in that time we were sure to go under」，一个月到不了南乔治亚，就是死路。还有一条他看重的考虑：象岛上根本不会有任何搜寻队来找他们。

The hazards of the ocean were plain, but the leader had priced the worst case. At worst the venture would add nothing to the risks of the men left on the island — there would be fewer mouths to feed through the winter — and the boat needed no more than a month's provisions for six, "for if we did not make South Georgia in that time we were sure to go under". And one consideration weighed with him: there was no chance at all of any search being made for them on Elephant Island.

dispositions.rationale: 已核查新补的 E35、E36、E37，稿件已有据覆盖，无需再改。story.8 已写明望见陆地后无法登陆、离岸停驶、遭遇飓风；也写明上岸后冰川和陡坡挡住通往内陆的路，必须驶向湾顶，捕鲸站在东岸。analysis.0 已写明留岛二十二人熬了四个半月，并声明不据此作因果评价。相关段落的 ev 已列入 E35、E36、E37，叙事、结局与因果均与证据一致。

evidence.quote: to have attempted a landing at that time would have been suicidal
At 5 a.m. thewind shifted to the north-west and quickly increased to one of the worst hurricanes any of us had ever experienced
It was obvious that these glaciers and the precipitous slopes of the mountains barred our way inland from the cove. We must sail to the head of the sound.
twenty-two of my comrades eked out a bare existence for four and a half months
